map.调节电压与线路压降核算: Regulation voltage and cable drop calculation

map.率 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m，单线电阻 = 0.0175 × 5 ÷ 2.5: resistivity is 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m, giving single-run resistance = 0.0175 × 5 ÷ 2.5 = 0.035 Ω and 0.07 Ω for the return pair; at 10 A the drop is 10 × 0.07 = 0.70 V (about 5.8%), leaving only 11.30 V at the far end. Cable drop should normally be kept within 3%, otherwise thicken the cable or shorten the run.
map.汽车发电机的调节电压多少算正常？: What counts as a normal alternator regulation voltage?
Most 12 V systems sit at 13.8~14.4 V across the battery with the engine running at moderate speed under light load; some models target 13.5~14.0 V to extend battery life, and readings may briefly reach 14.5~14.8 V in winter or after a deep discharge. Below 13.2 V the battery usually cannot be fully charged, and above 15.0 V there is a risk of overcharging and electrolyte loss, so both cases call for checks of the regulator and grounding.
map.为什么怠速时充电电流很小甚至为负？: Why is charging current small or even negative at idle?
map.发电机输出与转速相关，低于切入转速时输出不足以覆盖整车用电，缺口由蓄电池补充，此: Alternator output depends on speed: below the cut-in speed it cannot cover the vehicle's loads and the shortfall comes from the battery, so the ammeter reads near zero or negative. At idle an alternator typically delivers only 30%~50% of rated current, so idling for long periods with headlights, air conditioning and audio running nets a drain on the battery.
map.线路压降多少算过大？: How much cable voltage drop is too much?
map.一般建议整车供电线路在额定负载下压降不超过 3%（约 0.4 V），大灯、起动机: Generally keep vehicle supply wiring within 3% drop at rated load (about 0.4 V), relaxed to 5% for high-current circuits such as headlights and the starter. Large drops usually come from undersized cable, oxidized connectors, corroded ground points or excessive length. Always measure under load; an unloaded voltage reading cannot reveal true drop.
map.调节目标电压随温度补偿浮动，冷态与热态读数差异属正常: Target regulation voltage floats with temperature compensation, so cold and hot readings differing is normal
